---
title: About FreeCampus Math
description: Project purpose, commitments, scope, and governance.
page_type: about
---

FreeCampus Math is an open, institution-independent curriculum for learners
preparing for advanced quantitative and computational study.

The project commits to mathematical accuracy, complete reasoning, accessible
interaction, reproducible computation, learner privacy, and candid course
status. It claims no affiliation with a university, employer, or assessment.

Package and contributor material is intentionally secondary to the learner
courses. See [Contributing](contributing.qmd) to improve lessons, validators,
accessibility, or infrastructure.
